turns.patient_response: Lately I’ve been really bothered by these unwanted thoughts that just pop into my head and won’t go away. They make me feel very anxious and I end up spending a lot of time trying to push them away or neutralize them, and it’s starting to affect my day-to-day life.

symptom_reasoning.S065: The patient describes recurrent, unwanted thoughts that intrude ('unwanted thoughts that just pop into my head and won’t go away') and attempts to push them away or neutralize them, consistent with obsessions.
symptom_reasoning.S056: The patient reports that these thoughts make them feel 'very anxious,' indicating significant anxiety associated with these cognitions.
symptom_reasoning.S057: The patient notes that the thoughts 'won’t go away' despite efforts to push them away, suggesting difficulty controlling or stopping the worry/thoughts.
symptom_reasoning.S081: The patient states this is 'starting to affect my day-to-day life,' indicating a maladaptive emotional/behavioral response impacting functioning in response to these internal stressors.
